# An `open_prepayment:` summary under an account whose type is not one GnuCash has.
#
# What this fixture produces: Assets and Assets:Bank in CAD, and a refusal for
# Assets:Owed, whose type `NotAType` is no account type. The summary under it
# declares 5.00 CAD of credit for customer C1, and the book holds no such
# account, so it holds no such credit either.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_prepayment_summary_on_an_account_that_cannot_be_opened.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Owed
	type: NotAType
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	open_prepayment:
		customer: "C1"
		amount: 5.00 CAD
